detail.longDescription: I'm working on a Shopify store where the product page contains several dynamic sections, including product information, variant selection, related products, reviews, and custom content blocks. The page works correctly, but I'm trying to improve its loading performance, especially on mobile devices. I want to keep the existing functionality while reducing unnecessary JavaScript and improving the way Liquid sections and assets are loaded. I have already reviewed the theme structure and identified several JavaScript and CSS files that appear to load globally even when they are not required on every page. My goal is to: Load page-specific JavaScript and CSS only when needed. Reduce render-blocking resources. Avoid unnecessarily loading scripts on product pages. Keep Shopify's dynamic sections and variant functionality working correctly. Improve mobile performance without changing the visual design. What would be the recommended Shopify/Liquid approach for conditionally loading these assets while keeping the product page functionality intact? For example, should I handle this primarily through Liquid conditions in the theme layout, section-level asset loading, or another Shopify-supported approach?
